tldr: Lilith in the 6th house: the rebel against routine and the shamed body
body: Lilith in the 6th house: the rebel against routine and the shamed body. Where you reclaim autonomy over your work and health. Watch: self-sabotage disguised as defiance. You refuse to be a compliant worker or to ignore your body; raw instinct around labor and health. Resists being managed and is drawn to unconventional or independent work; clashes with bosses are common. Health here can mirror deeper emotional pressure, so treat the whole person, not just symptoms.
business: Sets fierce boundaries at work and actually listens to the body.
shadow: Defiant burnout, or repression that surfaces as illness.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith house material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
